en.shortDescription: Stone-coloured, three-seat L-shaped sofa. The supplier image shows the chaise on the right when viewed from the front.
en.description:
The YS 81217 has three backrest sections and an extended seat on one side in the supplier’s illustration. The supplier labels the Stone colourway Pet Friendly. Ask for the upholstery and cleaning instructions for this colourway when comparing fabrics.
To plan the L-shaped layout, measure the clear wall length and the depth available on the chaise side. Mark the chaise position on a photo or floor plan from the front of the sofa, especially if it sits near a balcony opening or walkway. Confirm the delivered orientation and assembled dimensions before ordering.

zh.shortDescription: Stone 石色三人位 L 形沙发。面向沙发看，供应商图示的贵妃位在右侧。
zh.description:
YS 81217 的供应商图示有三段靠背，其中一侧的座位加长。供应商把 Stone 石色款标为宠物友好，选面料时请核对这一色款的面料及清洁说明。
摆放前先量靠墙的可用长度，再单独量贵妃位一侧可以伸出多深。若靠近阳台门或通道，在平面图上标注门的开合方向，再从沙发正面标记需要的贵妃位方向。下单前请确认实际交付的方向和摆好后的外部尺寸。

en.shortDescription: Y201 modular sofa. The supplier’s diagram shows a configuration 300 cm wide, 95 cm deep and 75 cm high.
en.description:
The illustrated seat is 72 cm deep and 40 cm high. The armrest is marked 25 cm wide and 60 cm high, and the diagram specifies 5 cm solid-wood feet. These dimensions describe the combination in the diagram.
Use the 300 cm width to check your wall span and the 95 cm depth to check the passage past the front of the sofa. When considering another combination, ask for the dimensions of the selected modules and the largest piece that will need to pass through the entrance or lift.
Y201 is listed for pre-order. Confirm your module arrangement, fabric and colour together so that your quotation identifies the configuration you want.

zh.shortDescription: Y201 豆腐块模块沙发。供应商尺寸图所示组合宽 300、深 95、高 75 厘米。
zh.description:
图示座深 72 厘米、座高 40 厘米，扶手宽 25 厘米、高 60 厘米，实木脚高 5 厘米。这组尺寸对应图中的组合。
参照 300 厘米的总宽核对靠墙位置，并按 95 厘米的深度预留沙发前方的走动空间。若考虑别的组合，请确认各件尺寸，再比较最大单件与门口或电梯开口的净宽。
这款列于预购目录。询价时请把想要的模块组合、面料和颜色一起列明，方便在报价单上核对配置。

en.shortDescription: The supplier illustrations show the MF-069 as a straight upholstered sofa with a segmented back and rounded padded arms.
en.description:
Compare the full arm-to-arm width with the wall space you have. For delivery planning, measure the narrowest opening and identify any right-angle turn between the lift or staircase and the living room. Ask for the largest delivery piece and the assembled footprint for your selected configuration before checking clearance.
MF-069 is a pre-order item. The shop displays a size reference without a unit. Ask for the width, depth and height with units, together with the upholstery and quoted price, so your order can be checked against the configuration you have chosen.

zh.shortDescription: 供应商图示的 MF-069 普罗是一字形软包沙发，配分段式靠背和圆角软包扶手。
zh.description:
摆放时按两侧扶手外沿量整张沙发所需的宽度。安排进场前，量最窄的门口或电梯开口，并留意电梯或楼梯到客厅之间是否有转角。请先确认选定配置的摆放尺寸及配送时最大单件的尺寸，再核对能否搬入。
这款列于预购目录。商城参考尺寸未注明单位，询价时请一起确认宽、深、高及其单位、面料和当前报价，方便按选定的配置核对订单。

en.note:
Planning the bunk layout. Mark the catalogue footprint on the floor and check where the ladder opens onto the room. Measure the overhead space up to the lowest fixture near the top bunk, taking account of lights, ceiling fans and beams. Ask for the upper-bunk mattress dimensions and maximum thickness in the assembly instructions so that the guardrail clearance is checked for the mattress you intend to use.
Planning to separate the beds later? Ask for the outside dimensions of each single bed in the separated configuration, and confirm which parts and fixings are used for the conversion. Keep the assembly instructions and any parts needed for the separate configuration.
For a delivery enquiry, send the narrowest doorway measurement and any stair or lift turns, and ask for the longest packed piece and whether the mattress, carrying upstairs and assembly are quoted separately.

zh.note:
先按目录外尺寸在地面标出双层床的范围，查看梯口是否留有上下床的空间，并确认柜门和房门仍能打开。量上铺附近到横梁、吊灯或吊扇的最低净高。已有床垫的话，请量长、宽、厚，按该型号组装说明核对上铺可用床垫和护栏的净空要求。
打算以后把双层床分成两张单人床，可先问清分开后每张床的外尺寸、转换时要用的零件和安装步骤。预留两张床的位置时，以分床状态的实测或确认尺寸为准，保留随附说明和零件。
询问配送时可提供最窄门口的净宽、电梯开口和楼梯转角情况，确认最长包装件能否进门，并逐项确认报价是否包含床垫、搬上楼和组装。

en.shortDescription: BB 606-NTR natural-finish rubberwood bunk bed with a reversible ladder. Catalogue dimensions are 201 cm long, 102 cm deep and 172 cm high.
en.description:
The supplier specifies solid rubberwood and a full-panel solid-wood bed base with support legs. The catalogue lists a maximum of 200 kg per bed. Ask whether that figure includes the mattress and confirm the applicable limits for your configuration with the supplier before use. The catalogue identifies the country of manufacture as China and specifies self-assembly.
Choose the ladder side on your floor plan before assembly. Try the room door, wardrobe door and drawer swings on the plan, and keep the approach to the ladder clear. Check the clearance over the upper bunk at the lowest point of any beam, pendant or fan, and confirm the mattress size and maximum thickness against the assembly instructions.
Because the frame uses a full-panel base, check the dimensions of the longest panel when planning lift and stair access. Provide the narrowest clear opening on your route and ask which pieces are packed separately. Ask whether the quote includes a mattress, carrying beyond the entrance or assembly.

zh.shortDescription: BB 606-NTR 原木色橡胶木双层床，梯子可左右安装。目录外尺寸为长 201、深 102、高 172 厘米。
zh.description:
供应商标注床架为橡胶木实木，配带支撑腿的整面实木板床底。目录列明每张床最高承重 200 公斤，询价时请核对该上限是否包含床垫，以及所选配置适用的承重条件。目录注明中国制造，需自行组装。
规划梯子位置时，把房门、衣柜门以及抽屉拉出的范围标在平面图上，选择方便上下床的一侧。量上铺附近最低净高时，也要算上吊灯、横梁和吊扇。选床垫前，请按本款安装说明确认长宽、最大允许厚度及相应的护栏净空。
整面床板的包装方式会影响进场。若要走电梯或楼梯，可先询问最长部件和单件包装尺寸，并提供最窄的门口及转角尺寸。下单时请逐项核对报价是否含床垫、搬运上楼和组装。

en.shortDescription: Blue DOPHIN Queen bed frame, F162-F5-BLUE. The catalogue describes a solid-wood frame with PU upholstery and centre support legs.
en.description:
The supplier's product overview lists an overall width of 152 cm, length of 200 cm and height of 137 cm, a solid-wood bed base with centre support legs and compatibility with a Malaysian standard Queen mattress. The product is listed as made in China and requires self-assembly.
The same supplier lists 200 × 152 × 183 cm and 120 kg in a separate information table, without saying which measurement these refer to. When ordering F162-F5-BLUE, ask for the confirmed assembled height, the packed piece dimensions and the weight of any part you will need to move. These details matter if the headboard goes under a window or wall cabinet, or if the delivery route has a tight landing.
If you already have a mattress, measure its actual length and width and ask for the usable opening inside the frame. Place the confirmed outside dimensions on your room plan and leave room to open nearby wardrobe doors and drawers. Ask whether a mattress or assembly is included in the quote.

zh.shortDescription: 蓝色 DOPHIN 标准双人床架，型号 F162-F5-BLUE。目录标注实木框架配 PU 仿皮，床底有中心支撑腿。
zh.description:
供应商简介所列的床架外尺寸为宽 152、长 200、高 137 厘米，床底采用实木并带中心支撑腿，适用于马来西亚标准双人床垫。目录注明中国制造，需自行组装。
该供应商同页另有一张规格表，写着 200 × 152 × 183 厘米和 120 公斤，未说明这组数字量的是哪一部分。询价时请报蓝色型号 F162-F5-BLUE，分别确认组装后的床头高度、最大包装件尺寸及搬运件重量。床头要放在窗台或吊柜下，或者配送路线有短转角时，这几项尤其要先量清楚。
如已备有床垫，可提供实际长宽，核对床架内侧可用尺寸。按最终确认的外尺寸在房间放线，留出打开衣柜门和抽屉的空间，并确认报价是否包含床垫和组装。

en.shortDescription: Beige HD-0010 three-seat sofa. The catalogue lists an overall length of 218 cm, depth of 79 cm and height of 85 cm.
en.description:
The frame base is solid rubberwood. The catalogue describes easy-clean upholstery over high-density foam, and non-slip rubber pads beneath the cushions to help keep them in place. This model is listed as manufactured in Malaysia and requires self-assembly.
Use the outside length to mark the sofa against the wall, then account for the sofa depth, skirting or curtains and the space needed to walk past the front. If it sits near a balcony door or shelving, check opening clearance and how much access remains when the sofa is in position. For the beige finish, ask for a sample to check the colour in the lighting of your room.
The catalogue calls this model pet-friendly. Ask for the recommended cleaning method, whether the covers can be removed and which cleaners are suitable before treating a spill. To check delivery for the frame-and-cushion set, send the most restricted doorway or lift dimension and ask about the largest packaged part, the delivery fee and any separate assembly arrangement.

zh.shortDescription: 米色 HD-0010 三人沙发。目录外尺寸为长 218、深 79、高 85 厘米。
zh.description:
底座为橡胶木实木。目录标注易清洁面料和高密度海绵，座垫底部有防滑橡胶垫，以减少座垫移位。产地为马来西亚，需自行组装。
摆放前可在地面标出沙发的外长和进深，留意踢脚线、窗帘及沙发前方的通道。若靠近阳台门或收纳柜，开门试一下，确认门扇开启后仍能通行。选米色时，可询问是否有面料样本，在客厅日光和晚间灯光下分别看色。
目录商品名称标有宠物友好。养宠家庭可在购买前确认面料的清洁说明、座套能否拆洗及适用清洁剂。询价时请报米色款，若需经过较窄门口或公寓电梯，提供开口净尺寸和转角情况，并询问最大包装件尺寸、配送费和组装安排。

en.shortDescription: Mai Dao sofa with a high-resilience foam seat and straight carbon-steel legs. The supplier lists four nominal lengths in two upholstery finishes.
en.description:
The supplier lists lengths of 2.6 m, 2.8 m, 3.0 m and 3.2 m in both the Snowflake and chenille finishes. It also lists separate footstool options in the same two finishes.
Catalogue notes give a width of 100 cm and a height of 85 cm. The seat uses high-resilience foam, and the base has straight carbon-steel legs.
Before ordering, confirm the overall dimensions of the selected length and finish. If you want the footstool, ask for it to be listed separately on the quote so you can plan space for it in front of the sofa.

zh.shortDescription: 麦岛沙发采用高回弹海绵坐面和一字形碳钢脚。供应商目录列有四种长度，均有雪花与雪尼尔两种面料。
zh.description:
供应商分别列出了 2.6 米、2.8 米、3.0 米和 3.2 米四种长度。每种长度都有雪花和雪尼尔两种面料选项，同系列脚踏也分这两种面料。
目录备注标明宽 100 厘米、高 85 厘米，坐面填充高回弹海绵，底部为一字形碳钢脚。
下单前请按所选长度和面料核对整件家具的尺寸。如果需要脚踏，可以请报价单把它单列，并在试摆时一并预留沙发前方的空间。

en.shortDescription: White BASTIA round dining table with a 135 cm sintered-stone top, metal base and an included 80 cm Lazy Susan.
en.description:
The BASTIA table is 135 cm in diameter and 75 cm high. The supplier lists a sintered-stone tabletop, a metal base with gold-coloured trim and an 80 cm diameter turntable included with the table.
This is the white version, catalogue reference SLC 0435. The supplier lists it as made in China and requiring self-assembly.
For a room-fit check, mark the 135 cm tabletop outline on the floor. Measure the chairs you intend to use and check the walkway with them pulled out. Before ordering, confirm what is included in the quote and where you have space to assemble the table.

zh.shortDescription: BASTIA 白色岩板圆餐桌，直径 135 厘米，配金属底座和直径 80 厘米的转盘。
zh.description:
餐桌整体直径 135 厘米、高 75 厘米。供应商目录列明岩板桌面、带金色饰边的金属底座，餐桌随附直径 80 厘米的转盘。
这款为白色，目录编号 SLC 0435。供应商标注为中国制造，需自行组装。
试摆时可以先按 135 厘米的直径在地面标出桌面边界，再用计划搭配的椅子核对拉开后还有多少通道。下单前请核对报价单的包含项，也可以先留出方便组装桌体的位置。

en.shortDescription: Natural-finish GALLE solid ash desk with two drawers, a desktop hutch with soft-closing glass doors and a hanging hook on each side.
en.description:
The GALLE desk and hutch measure 120 cm long, 60 cm deep and 188 cm high overall. The supplier lists a drawer interior of 46 cm wide, 27 cm deep and 5 cm high. There are two drawers, a desktop hutch with soft-closing glass doors and a hanging hook on either side of the desk.
The supplier lists solid ash, a natural finish, manufacture in China and self-assembly.
Use the overall height to check under an existing shelf or soffit. If you intend to place a monitor under the hutch, check the actual clearance below the hutch with the supplier, using your monitor and stand measurements. Check that a bag hung on the side hook can clear any adjacent wall or cabinet.

zh.shortDescription: GALLE 原木色白蜡木实木书桌，配两个抽屉、带缓闭玻璃门的桌上书架，桌身左右各有挂钩。
zh.description:
书桌连书架的整体尺寸为长 120 厘米、深 60 厘米、高 188 厘米。供应商标注的抽屉内部尺寸为宽 46、深 27、高 5 厘米。两个抽屉与桌上书架是分别使用的收纳空间，书架有缓闭玻璃门，桌身两侧均有挂钩。
这款采用白蜡木实木，目录标示为原木色、中国制造，需自行组装。
摆在吊柜或横梁下方时，可先按 188 厘米总高核对上方净空。如果打算把显示器放在书架下面，请把显示器与底座的总高一起量好，再核对书架下的实际净高。靠墙摆放时也可先量桌侧空间，确认挂包后是否顺手。
